opening.argument: The offer is tied directly to paid entry and mining-pool purchases: starting the business requires a $100 lifetime membership, followed by buying a pool, and the displayed pools have prices and Buy Now buttons. It then links the opportunity to referrals, package purchases, and team volume, with commissions described across multiple indirect levels. Those are concrete purchase and recruitment incentives, not simply a discussion of mining. Although the speaker says returns are variable and does not commit to a daily percentage, that limitation does not change the direct solicitation to pay for membership and mining power or the financial rewards tied to recruitment.

citations.quote: when you start the business you must pay $100 for a membership this membership is for life
then you buy a mining pool, depending on how much money you have to be able to develop this business
when you refer to the first and the second they won 5% of the initial packages
I do not commit to giving you a daily percentage, because in mining that does not exist. Everything is variable in mining
